system_description.narrative_title: Escalating U.S.-Iran war and global economic spillovers
system_description.narrative_summary: A sustained U.S.-Iran military confrontation, accompanied by stepped-up sanctions and financial pressure, is reverberating across Gulf security, global energy supplies, and international finance. As kinetic strikes (e.g., Larak/Kharg) and Iranian assertions over the Strait of Hormuz interact with secondary sanctions targeting banks and dollar clearing, oil prices, markets, and regional alignments are shifting. This functions as an open system: military, economic, informational and diplomatic flows cross borders continuously, producing feedbacks (market shocks, sanctions circumvention, regional escalation) that reshape actor behavior.
system_description.scope: Inside the system boundary are U.S.-Iran military exchanges (strikes, retaliations), Iranian control of maritime chokepoints (Strait of Hormuz), U.S. secondary sanctions and banking restrictions (targeting banks and dollar clearing), Gulf states' policy responses (UAE, Saudi actions), global oil production/exports and shipping/logistics, and effects on global financial markets and munition stocks.
system_description.super_system: International security and the global energy-economy
adjacent_subsystems: Global energy markets and supply chains
International banking, payments and sanctions enforcement
Gulf regional security architecture and state alignments
Global financial markets and investor risk sentiment
evidence_headlines: U.S. strikes Iranian rocket launchers near Strait of Hormuz
US Treasury imposes limits on Egyptian bank for doing business with Iran
Iran insists Strait of Hormuz remains closed as war enters seventh month
US campaign to isolate Iran closes in on Dubai
Global oil prices top $91 a barrel after U.S. and Iran exchange fire for the first time in a month
U.S. strikes Iran for first time in weeks in attack on rocket launchers

variables.name: Military engagement intensity
variables.description: Measures the frequency and scale of kinetic military exchanges and operations between adversarial forces in the theater.

variables.name: Maritime chokepoint control
variables.description: Measures the degree of effective control or denial exercised over key maritime passages used for commercial energy shipments.

variables.name: Secondary sanctions pressure
variables.description: Measures the intensity and scope of extraterritorial economic penalties and restrictions applied to third parties for dealing with sanctioned actors.

variables.name: Dollar clearing restriction level
variables.description: Measures the extent to which access to dollar-denominated payment and clearing systems is curtailed for targeted counterparties.

variables.name: Oil production and export capacity
variables.description: Measures the available physical capacity for crude oil and related product output and shipments to global markets.

variables.name: Shipping logistics disruption rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which commercial shipping operations are delayed, rerouted, or halted due to security, insurance, or operational impediments.

variables.name: Global oil price level
variables.description: Measures prevailing international benchmark prices for crude oil that reflect supply-demand and risk premia.

variables.name: Financial market volatility
variables.description: Measures the degree of price variability and uncertainty across major financial asset classes and markets.

variables.name: Investor risk appetite
variables.description: Measures the aggregate willingness of investors to hold riskier assets versus seeking safe-haven assets.

variables.name: Munitions inventory levels
variables.description: Measures the quantity of available conventional munitions and related military supplies held in reserves or accessible stocks.

variables.name: Sanctions circumvention activity
variables.description: Measures the rate and sophistication of efforts to bypass economic restrictions through alternative financial channels, intermediaries, or trade practices.

variables.name: Regional alignment shift rate
variables.description: Measures the pace at which states in the region change security, economic, or diplomatic alignments in response to the conflict.

variables.name: Energy supply risk perception
variables.description: Measures market and stakeholder perceptions of the probability and potential impact of disruptions to energy supply chains.

variables.name: Inflationary pressure
variables.description: Measures upward pressure on general price levels in affected economies driven by higher energy and logistic costs and supply shocks.

variables.name: Energy infrastructure damage rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which energy production, refining, storage, and transport infrastructure is degraded or destroyed by hostile action or related incidents.

variables.name: Global trade flow volume
variables.description: Measures the aggregate volume of cross-border trade flows that rely on the maritime and transactional routes affected by the crisis.

catalysts.title: Prolonged Iranian closure/control of Strait of Hormuz
catalysts.description: Iran continues to assert control and pressure over the Strait, maintaining restrictions or de facto closure that sustain elevated transit risk.
catalysts.rationale: Iran insists Strait remains closed; navy says it has 'full control' (Aug 30–31 headlines).

catalysts.title: Continued U.S. naval interdiction/blockade of Iranian exports
catalysts.description: U.S. naval operations and enforcement actions further restrict Iran's ability to export oil and maritime traffic tied to Iranian trade.
catalysts.rationale: U.S. Navy blockade slashes Iran oil exports; recent strikes near Strait (Aug 30–31 headlines).

catalysts.title: Renewed U.S. strikes on Iranian launchers/facilities
catalysts.description: U.S. forces continue targeted strikes against Iranian launchers and military sites, prompting reciprocal attacks and instability.
catalysts.rationale: U.S. strikes on Larak island and other Iranian launchers; Trump vows to 'hit them hard' (Aug 30–Sep 1).

catalysts.title: Iranian/IRGC attacks on regional bases and assets
catalysts.description: Iranian forces and proxies continue strikes on U.S. and regional bases (Jordan, UAE claims), sustaining cross-border kinetic exchanges.
catalysts.rationale: IRGC says it launched attacks on U.S. bases in Jordan; Iran claims strike on Al Minhad base (Aug 31–Sep 1).

catalysts.title: Ongoing weekly U.S. secondary sanctions campaign
catalysts.description: U.S. administration pursues frequent new secondary sanctions and designations, expanding extraterritorial pressure on banks and intermediaries.
catalysts.rationale: Bessent expects new US secondary sanctions weekly; Treasury sanctions Egyptian bank branches (Aug 30–31).

catalysts.title: Expansion of U.S. dollar-clearing restrictions on Gulf banks
catalysts.description: U.S. moves to block dollar clearing and target Gulf bank branches (Egyptian/UAE) escalate, constraining dollar access for regional banks.
catalysts.rationale: US Treasury limits on Egyptian bank, UAE branch sanctions, investigations into Banque Misr (Aug 30–31).

catalysts.title: Continued drain on U.S. munitions and resupply constraints
catalysts.description: Sustained combat operations deplete U.S. munitions stocks, pressuring resupply and potentially constraining future operational tempo.
catalysts.rationale: Drain on U.S. munitions raises concerns about deterrence and supply (Aug 30 headline).

catalysts.title: Sustained oil price spike above ~$90
catalysts.description: Risk-driven and supply-reduction dynamics push global oil benchmarks to remain elevated, amplifying inflation and market stress.
catalysts.rationale: Brent jumps above $90; global oil tops $91 after exchanges of fire (Aug 31–Sep 1 headlines).

catalysts.title: U.S. isolation campaign targets Dubai financial links
catalysts.description: Pressure on Dubai and its banks intensifies as U.S. campaign seeks to isolate Iran, prompting investigations and potential restrictions on Dubai-based intermediaries.
catalysts.rationale: US campaign to isolate Iran 'closes in on Dubai'; UAE investigates Banque Misr after US moves (Aug 30–31).
